INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AJUTHORITY OF INDIA
## ## **Circular** ## - CEOs/CMDs of all Insurers and Exempted Insurers # 1. On the basis of the submissions made by Cross Border Reinsurer (CBR) and recommendations of the insurers, the Authority has granted approval to the below mentioned CBR’s , who do not fulfil stipulated eligibility criteria. - **FRN** I **Name of CBR #** I **Country** I - CBR00830268/202021 Bao Viet Insurance Corporation Vietnam - CBR00330269/202021 Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Ltd. Kenya ## - CBR00060272/202021 National Reinsurance Organisation” Belarus - CBR00900273/202021 Royal Insurance Corporation of Bhutan Ltd. Bhutan CBR00590274/202021 Insurance Company of GAZ Industry (SOGAZ) Russia - CBR00740275/202021 Sompo Sigorta A.S Turkey b. Reinsurance placements by an insurer to the above stated CBR’s shall not exceed **two percent (2%)** c. The insurer(s) shall comply with clause 6 (VIII) of the IRDAI Guidelines No. IRDAI/NL/GDL/RIN/017/01/2016 dated 19-01- **Executive Director**
